name: Falrae
bio: Falrae watches over the Wanewood, a forest locked in eternal autumn where the Ancients go to rejoin the cycle of nature. Falrae guides them to their rest, and celebrates life with the other Eldrin that come there. But her eyes stay sharp, for not all who come to the Wanewood have good intentions…
